scenes.line1: How do you check 200 servers fast?
scenes.say: Ever been asked how you’d check something across hundreds of servers? Let’s see how to do it efficiently.

scenes.label: xargs
scenes.sub: Run port checks on many hosts at once.
scenes.say: Use xargs to test ports in parallel. It’s quick for small lists, and you control how many run at a time.

scenes.title: Run commands over SSH
scenes.say: Loop with SSH to run commands on each host. Batch mode skips password prompts, so the script won’t hang.
For real fleets, switch to Ansible. It’s built for scale and handles errors and parallelism for you.

scenes.question: Why does your SSH loop stop after one host?
scenes.right: SSH eats standard input; use SSH dash n or read from a different file descriptor to fix it.
scenes.say: Watch out: SSH can consume the input stream, causing your loop to stop early. Know how to avoid that.
